# NHANES 2017-2018 - COLUMN AND VALUE CODE DICTIONARY
#
# Every column of every XPT file in this folder, with the meaning of its values.
# Source: CDC codebooks https://wwwn.cdc.gov/Nchs/Data/Nhanes/Public/2017/DataFiles/<FILE>.htm
# Labels, question texts and code meanings are copied verbatim from CDC.
# NHANES = National Health and Nutrition Examination Survey; CDC = Centers for Disease Control and Prevention.
#
# FORMAT: one record per line, fields separated by ' | '. Lines starting with '#' are comments.
#   ABBR | term | meaning                                   abbreviations used in labels and codes
#   FILE | file | title                                     one per XPT file
#   VAR  | file | variable | CDC label | CDC question/description text
#   CODE | file | variable | code | meaning                 one per value code of that variable
#
# For continuous columns the code is a range (e.g. '3.2 to 242.6') with meaning 'Range of Values'.
# 'file' is the XPT name without .xpt; 'variable' is the column name exactly as in the XPT.
#
# R:
#   x <- readLines('data/raw/nhanes/2017-2018/_file_list.txt', encoding = 'UTF-8')
#   f <- lapply(strsplit(x[grepl('^(ABBR|FILE|VAR|CODE) ', x)], ' | ', fixed = TRUE), trimws)
#   rec <- function(type, cols) setNames(as.data.frame(do.call(rbind, lapply(Filter(function(r) r[1] == type, f), `[`, -1))), cols)
#   vars  <- rec('VAR',  c('file', 'variable', 'label', 'description'))
#   codes <- rec('CODE', c('file', 'variable', 'code', 'meaning'))

ABBR | _J | File suffix for the NHANES 2017-2018 cycle (each 2-year cycle has its own letter)
ABBR | SS (file prefix) | Surplus specimen: lab tests run later on stored leftover blood or urine, usually on a random subsample
ABBR | (Surplus) | Same as SS prefix: results from stored leftover specimens
ABBR | XPT | SAS transport file format used by CDC to publish NHANES data
ABBR | NHANES | National Health and Nutrition Examination Survey
ABBR | CDC | Centers for Disease Control and Prevention (United States)
ABBR | NCHS | National Center for Health Statistics (part of CDC, runs NHANES)
ABBR | SEQN | Respondent sequence number; unique participant ID and the join key across all files
ABBR | SP | Sample person: the selected survey participant
ABBR | HH | Household
ABBR | HH ref person | Household reference person: the adult who owns or rents the home
ABBR | MEC | Mobile Examination Center: the trailer where exams and blood draws happen
ABBR | ACASI | Audio Computer-Assisted Self-Interview: participant answers sensitive questions privately on a computer
ABBR | Proxy | Someone else answered for the participant (for example a parent for a child)
ABBR | PSU | Primary sampling unit: the first-stage sampling area (usually a county)
ABBR | pseudo-PSU / pseudo-stratum | Masked versions of PSU and stratum released for variance estimation
ABBR | Sample weight | Number of people in the US population that a participant represents; needed for national estimates
ABBR | Subsample weight | Sample weight for a random subsample (used for tests not done on everyone)
ABBR | Comment code | Lab flag column: tells whether the result is at or above the detection limit or below it
ABBR | Invalidity code | Scan quality flag in DXA files: tells whether a body region measurement is valid
ABBR | Status code | Tells whether a component was completed, partly completed or not done
ABBR | NH | Non-Hispanic
ABBR | NHW | Non-Hispanic White
ABBR | NHB | Non-Hispanic Black
ABBR | US | United States
ABBR | USDA | United States Department of Agriculture
ABBR | NIH | National Institutes of Health
ABBR | FTC | Federal Trade Commission (published standardized cigarette tar, nicotine and carbon monoxide contents)
ABBR | WIC | Special Supplemental Nutrition Program for Women, Infants, and Children
ABBR | FS | Food stamps (now called SNAP, Supplemental Nutrition Assistance Program)
ABBR | CHIP | Children's Health Insurance Program
ABBR | Medi-Gap | Medigap: private insurance that supplements Medicare
ABBR | RR | Railroad Retirement (federal pension program for railroad workers)
ABBR | UPC | Universal Product Code (barcode number)
ABBR | ICD-10-CM | International Classification of Diseases, 10th Revision, Clinical Modification (diagnosis code system)
ABBR | BMI | Body mass index: weight (kg) divided by height (m) squared
ABBR | BP | Blood pressure
ABBR | BPXO | Blood pressure measured by an automatic oscillometric device
ABBR | SBP | Systolic blood pressure (the upper number)
ABBR | DBP | Diastolic blood pressure (the lower number)
ABBR | HBP | High blood pressure (hypertension)
ABBR | HR | Heart rate
ABBR | MIL | Maximum inflation level of the blood pressure cuff
ABBR | DXA / DXX | Dual-energy X-ray absorptiometry: low-dose X-ray scan of bone and body composition
ABBR | BMC | Bone mineral content (grams)
ABBR | BMD | Bone mineral density (grams per square centimeter)
ABBR | VAT | Visceral adipose tissue: fat around the organs inside the abdomen
ABBR | SAT | Subcutaneous adipose tissue: fat under the skin
ABBR | Android / Gynoid | Android = abdominal region; gynoid = hip and thigh region (DXA fat distribution)
ABBR | L1, L2, L3, L4 | First to fourth lumbar vertebrae (lower spine)
ABBR | K, D0 (written DO) | Calibration constants calculated by the DXA scanner software; D0 is written 'DO' in CDC labels
ABBR | CAP | Controlled attenuation parameter: liver fat measure from elastography (dB/m)
ABBR | E | In liver elastography: liver stiffness (elasticity) in kilopascals
ABBR | IQRc / IQRe | Interquartile range of CAP / of stiffness E (measurement variability)
ABBR | Tymp | Tympanometry: test of eardrum and middle-ear function
ABBR | A1C | Hemoglobin A1C (glycohemoglobin): average blood sugar over about 3 months
ABBR | HDL | High-density lipoprotein ('good' cholesterol)
ABBR | LDL | Low-density lipoprotein ('bad' cholesterol)
ABBR | Friedewald / Martin-Hopkins / NIH equation 2 | Three formulas for calculating LDL cholesterol
ABBR | RBC | Red blood cell(s)
ABBR | WBC | White blood cell(s)
ABBR | Hgb / Hb | Hemoglobin
ABBR | HS | High-sensitivity (as in high-sensitivity C-reactive protein)
ABBR | ALT | Alanine aminotransferase (liver enzyme)
ABBR | AST | Aspartate aminotransferase (liver enzyme)
ABBR | ALP | Alkaline phosphatase (liver and bone enzyme)
ABBR | GGT | Gamma-glutamyl transferase (liver enzyme)
ABBR | LDH | Lactate dehydrogenase (enzyme released by damaged tissue)
ABBR | CPK | Creatine phosphokinase (muscle enzyme)
ABBR | TIBC | Total iron binding capacity
ABBR | UIBC | Unsaturated iron binding capacity
ABBR | AGP | Alpha-1-acid glycoprotein (inflammation marker)
ABBR | SHBG | Sex hormone-binding globulin
ABBR | FSH | Follicle-stimulating hormone
ABBR | TST | Sex steroid hormone (testosterone) panel; used in the SSTST_J weight name
ABBR | 17a | 17-alpha (as in 17-alpha-hydroxyprogesterone)
ABBR | PHQ-9 | Patient Health Questionnaire, 9 items (depression screener)
ABBR | COPD | Chronic obstructive pulmonary disease
ABBR | PID | Pelvic inflammatory disease
ABBR | HPV | Human papillomavirus
ABBR | HIV | Human immunodeficiency virus (HIV-1 and HIV-2 are its two types)
ABBR | CMV | Cytomegalovirus
ABBR | HCV | Hepatitis C virus
ABBR | HDV / anti-HDV | Hepatitis D virus / antibody against it
ABBR | HEV / anti-HEV | Hepatitis E virus / antibody against it
ABBR | RNA | Ribonucleic acid (here: viral genetic material, shows active infection)
ABBR | IgG | Immunoglobulin G: antibody showing past infection or immunity
ABBR | IgM | Immunoglobulin M: antibody showing recent infection

ABBR | D2 / D3 | Vitamin D2 (ergocalciferol, from plants) / vitamin D3 (cholecalciferol, from skin and animal foods)
